remarks: Set high on a desirable New Canaan Ridge, this exceptional 3.2-acre property is a rare gem. Surrounded by beautiful Connecticut stone walls and mature trees, it offers a serene, park-like setting. The 1910 home is ready for renovation, or you can start fresh and build your dream home. With endless possibilities, 1179 Ponus Ridge presents a unique opportunity to create something truly special. Don't miss your chance to own this one-of-a-kind property in a prime location.  Please do not walk on the property without a confirmed appointment. Owner lives on the property.
